Palworld Server Settings Generator

Edit the settings below (defaults pre-filled), then generate a ready-to-paste OptionSettings line for your PalWorldSettings.ini. All 62 settings from Palworld 1.0 included.

SettingValue

Output

Select settings and click Generate.

How to use the output

  1. Stop your server and open Pal\Saved\Config\WindowsServer\PalWorldSettings.ini.
  2. Replace the OptionSettings=(...) line with the generated line.
  3. Save, restart the server, and verify in game that the changes applied.
  4. Back up the file before editing — a broken line can prevent the server from starting.
